title: FloodGuard Limits and Deductible Options by Tier
content:
Under the FloodGuard Private Flood Policy the building limit, the contents limit and the two deductibles are chosen within the ranges each tier allows, and limits change in the tier's own step.

## Limits

| Tier | Lowest building limit (USD) | Highest building limit (USD) | Highest contents limit (USD) | Limit step (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FloodGuard Contents Only | 0 | 0 | 50000 | 1000 |
| FloodGuard Essential | 50000 | 250000 | 100000 | 1000 |
| FloodGuard Standard | 100000 | 500000 | 150000 | 1000 |
| FloodGuard Plus | 100000 | 750000 | 250000 | 5000 |
| FloodGuard Premier | 150000 | 1000000 | 300000 | 5000 |
| FloodGuard High Value | 250000 | 2500000 | 500000 | 10000 |

The building limit of FloodGuard Contents Only is 0 at both ends because no building property is insured on that tier. The limit step is the step in which building and contents limits are changed.

## Deductible options

| Tier | Building deductibles allowed (USD) | Contents deductibles allowed (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| FloodGuard Contents Only | none | 1000 or 2000 |
| FloodGuard Essential | 1000, 2000 or 5000 | 1000, 2000 or 5000 |
| FloodGuard Standard | 1000, 2000, 5000 or 10000 | 1000, 2000 or 5000 |
| FloodGuard Plus | 2000, 5000 or 10000 | 2000, 5000 or 10000 |
| FloodGuard Premier | 5000, 10000 or 25000 | 5000 or 10000 |
| FloodGuard High Value | 10000, 25000 or 50000 | 10000 or 25000 |

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical)

- On FloodGuard Plus, where the step is 5,000 USD, a change to a hypothetical building limit of 400,000 USD moves it to 405,000 USD, 410,000 USD and so on, never to 402,000 USD.
- On FloodGuard Standard, a hypothetical building limit of 500,000 USD is already the highest building limit the tier allows.
- A building deductible of 1,000 USD is among the options of FloodGuard Essential and Standard only.
